spec.limitations_zh: Studio定义与虚构演算；未启动Few采集/消费者，未创建业务存储或写真实榜单。历史覆盖、版本适配、物理绑定、真实排名质量未核验。

metric_compatibility.legacy_consumers: Accept v1 and v2; project existing fields with unchanged v1 semantics, frozen identity and metric_id. RVOL adds no scoring contribution.
metric_compatibility.new_hottest_consumer: Only market_indicators_v2; unavailable RVOL contributes Z=0 without excluding the coin or reallocating weights. No silent v1 fallback.
metric_compatibility.upgrade_boundary: Explicit per-message version routing before thresholds. Never rewrite old frozen v1 messages or change their IDs.

history_rules: Per target choose requested_at≤target, target−requested_at≤30min, requested_at≤collected_at≤target, observed_at≤collected_at.
Require seven distinct daily targets/observation IDs; no current/future or late data.
Current volume≥0, historical volume≥0, baseline mean>0; missing history affects RVOL only.
No automatic history collector/backfill; reuse the 14-day archive design; real coverage unknown.
batch_rules: One crawler round produces one frozen ranking batch only after all its indicator results arrive and coverage is healthy and complete; no fixed five-minute schedule or mixed-round inputs.
Freeze latest observed input per asset at one cutoff before checking RVOL; no fallback to older complete metrics.
Freeze cohort, coverage, parameters, normalization stats, observations and result under snapshot_id; retry identical payload or reject conflict.
Identity resolved, object_kind coin, USD, finite positive price and market cap, source age≤15min; do not apply old volume/cap scoring gates.
Legacy asset/token kind values need an explicit verified coin adapter, not guessing from symbol.
Partial/failed/unknown coverage blocks publication; empty complete batches differ from failures.
Stablecoins/wrapped assets may remain; no unapproved classification filter.
Rank is cohort-relative, not a promise of news, investment value or absolute market activity.
Unavailable RVOL retains otherwise qualified coins; original RVOL is null, Z and contribution are zero, weights unchanged.
RVOL statistics use only valid RVOL candidates; other three metrics use the entire qualified cohort.
Nonempty qualified cohort with no valid RVOL sets snapshot rvol_warmup=true; mixed, complete and empty cohorts set false. Display 暂按三项排序 for warmup and — for missing RVOL multiples.

cards.description_zh: 按同一cutoff保存每个资产最新指标和覆盖；先选最新再判历史完整性，不回退旧合格指标。
cards.description_en: Keep each asset’s latest as-of metrics and coverage; never substitute an older history-complete observation.
cards.algorithm_zh: 接收market_indicators_v2，按来源稳定ID和已核实UUID幂等更新；本轮冻结全体最新候选、样本范围、覆盖与输入引用。失败/身份冲突隔离；物理存储与恢复绑定待Few核验。 RVOL不可用不剔除币：原值null，仅放量项Z/贡献为0，权重不变；RVOL统计仅用有效值，其他三项用全部合格候选。非空合格候选全缺RVOL时快照rvol_warmup=true，前端注明「暂按三项排序」；缺失倍数显示「—」。
cards.algorithm_en: Consume v2, resolve stable source identity, and freeze a batch of latest candidates with cutoff, coverage and references. Isolate conflicts; physical storage and recovery remain unbound. Unavailable RVOL keeps qualified coins with null raw values and zero RVOL Z/contribution, unchanged weights. RVOL statistics use valid values only; other metrics use all qualified candidates. Nonempty all-missing RVOL cohorts set rvol_warmup=true: “Temporarily ranked by three metrics”; missing multiples show “—”.

cards.name: 生成基础最热榜
cards.description_zh: 对整批CoinGecko候选计算四指标稳健Z交易热度，按当前分数取前20。
cards.description_en: Rank the current cohort by four-factor robust Z trading heat; top 20.
cards.algorithm_zh: 同批次每项y=ln(1+x)，Z=(y−median(y))/(1.4826×MAD(y))并截断[−3,+3]。热度=0.35×Z(RVOL)+0.25×Z(换手率)+0.20×Z(成交额)+0.20×Z(绝对涨跌幅)。MAD尺度≤1e−12的分项全体0并标注退化，不重分配权重；全部退化不可比较。全精度排序，同分asset_id升序。直接快照排名，不读旧activity_score、不累计或衰减。 RVOL不可用不剔除币：原值null，仅放量项Z/贡献为0，权重不变；RVOL统计仅用有效值，其他三项用全部合格候选。非空合格候选全缺RVOL时快照rvol_warmup=true，前端注明「暂按三项排序」；缺失倍数显示「—」。
cards.algorithm_en: Within one frozen cohort, transform log1p, center by median and scale by 1.4826 MAD; clip Z to [−3,+3]. Weights: RVOL .35, turnover .25, volume .20, absolute move .20. Degenerate scale ≤1e−12 contributes zero without reweighting; all-degenerate batches are incomparable. Sort full precision, then asset ID. No event accumulation or decay. Unavailable RVOL keeps qualified coins with null raw values and zero RVOL Z/contribution, unchanged weights. RVOL statistics use valid values only; other metrics use all qualified candidates. Nonempty all-missing RVOL cohorts set rvol_warmup=true: “Temporarily ranked by three metrics”; missing multiples show “—”.
cards.trigger_zh: 每收齐一轮爬虫算一次；同轮指标收齐、覆盖健康且完整才冻结并计算一批；来源≤15分钟，失败不使用旧榜冒充当前。

cards.name: CoinGecko · 计算升温日冻结基准
cards.description_zh: 独立升温7日常态；每日更新，日内固定。
cards.algorithm_zh: 每天UTC00:00（上海08:00）固定基准版本；取前1—7个UTC日界各一条同源同资产USD同覆盖、当时已收到且不晚于目标最多30分钟旧的有效滚动24h观测，算均值。7条完整且均值>0才可用；不补零、不用迟到数据改写旧基准；日内复用，不修改最热7日RVOL。
cards.algorithm_en: Freeze seven prior UTC-midnight rolling-24h observations each day; do not reuse hottest RVOL as this baseline.
cards.trigger_zh: 所属升温程序在新UTC日界首次完整批次选择并冻结新基准，日内复用；不另启动基准爬虫。

cards.description_zh: 近期增长速度排序，双榜允许重叠，增长是否加快另作解释。
cards.algorithm_zh: 当前量V、日冻结均值B、1h前量H：R=V/B，G=V/H−1；R>1且G>0入选，按G降序、R降序、asset_id升序取最多10。不排除最热榜资产，不读旧累计评分。2h历史可用时比较前段H/H2−1，变化=(G−前段)×100百分点，仅作加快/稳定/放缓解释，不参与排序；2h缺失不剔除。
cards.algorithm_en: Rank positive 1h growth above the daily seven-day baseline. Allow hottest overlap; acceleration is explanatory, never a ranking weight.

cards.name: leaderboard_warming
cards.description_zh: 原子升温快照：增长率、常态倍数、是否加快及完整追溯。
cards.algorithm_zh: 当前量V、日冻结均值B、1h前量H：R=V/B，G=V/H−1；R>1且G>0入选，按G降序、R降序、asset_id升序取最多10。不排除最热榜资产，不读旧累计评分。2h历史可用时比较前段H/H2−1，变化=(G−前段)×100百分点，仅作加快/稳定/放缓解释，不参与排序；2h缺失不剔除。
cards.algorithm_en: Atomic warming rows ordered by growth, baseline multiple, then asset ID; no score ledger or hottest exclusion.
cards.trigger_zh: 每收齐一轮有效行情指标后按冻结cutoff演算；测试12分钟/正式3分钟为用户报告的采集节奏，不增加小时定时器。

fields.name: asset_id
fields.label_zh: 可空UUID；最热榜仅接已核实coin

fields.name: asset_name
fields.label_zh: 展示名，不参与身份匹配

fields.name: object_kind
fields.label_zh: 最热候选须coin；旧asset/token标签须显式适配

fields.name: warming_baseline_mean_7d
fields.label_zh: 升温日冻结7日成交额均值，不是最热随观测更新基线

fields.name: warming_baseline_days
fields.label_zh: 匹配到的历史日目标数，完整要求7

fields.name: warming_baseline_refs_json
fields.label_zh: 七个UTC日界目标及实际历史观测引用

fields.name: warming_baseline_status
fields.label_zh: 完整/缺历史/零基准/冲突状态

fields.name: warming_multiple
fields.label_zh: 当前滚动24h成交额／升温日冻结基准

fields.name: history_1h_volume
fields.label_zh: 一小时前目标匹配的滚动24h成交额，非新增1h成交额

fields.name: history_1h_ref_json
fields.label_zh: 1h比较目标、实际采样时间、观测引用

fields.name: history_2h_volume
fields.label_zh: 两小时前目标匹配的滚动24h成交额，仅用于解释

fields.name: history_2h_ref_json
fields.label_zh: 2h比较目标、实际采样时间、观测引用

fields.name: growth_1h
fields.label_zh: 近期1h目标成交额增长率，小数0.2表示20%

fields.name: previous_growth_1h
fields.label_zh: 前一个1h目标窗口增长率，小数

fields.name: growth_change_pp
fields.label_zh: 两段增长率差，百分点；不参与排名，不是新增成交额加速度

fields.name: growth_change_status
fields.label_zh: 加快/近似稳定/放缓/历史不足

fields.name: warming_status
fields.label_zh: 指标完整或不可用原因

fields.name: rank
fields.label_zh: 近期增长率降序、常态倍数降序、asset_id升序

fields.name: score
fields.label_zh: 兼容下游排序字段，值等于growth_1h，非旧评分/Z

fields.name: snapshot_id
fields.label_zh: 同一输入/版本/批次冻结标识

fields.name: sample_count
fields.label_zh: 本轮合格当前候选数，截取前

fields.name: warming_warmup
fields.label_zh: 有合格当前候选但无完整基准/1h指标；空批为false

fields.name: reason
fields.label_zh: 成交额、增长和基准的事实解释，不推断巨鲸或内幕

fields.name: price_direction
fields.label_zh: 来源24h涨跌方向，不称作1h方向

fields.name: window_start
fields.label_zh: 来源未给出滚动统计起点则null

fields.name: window_end
fields.label_zh: 来源未给出滚动统计止点则null

requirements_zh: 各渠道统一建档成功后按系统首次created_at倒序取最新20个，同刻asset_id升序；不是项目上线日期，不按UUID字符串判断新旧。
身份确认后才入榜，不设置热度、市值、成交量或涨跌门槛；不改变资产建档准入。
来源新增、重新抓取和身份纠错不得刷新首次建档时间；多渠道同对象沿用原UUID。
批量初始化、迁移、重导入与UUID替换不制造实时新发现；须绑定持久的创建来源判定，未知则该榜不可用。
非法、未来或未知首次时间不补当前时间；单项不合格先过滤，完整有效资产集合排序再limit。
整批成功发布，结果15分钟有效；无合格对象可发布空批次，不拿旧结果补齐。
新榜可含不同对象类型；代币内容链只接收confirmed且asset_kind=coin的稳定asset_id，其他类型生成能力未绑定。
新发现不发评分奖励，不恢复旧发现+20或7天规则。
spec.limitations_zh: 工作台定义与虚构演算；无生产榜单、来源读取、任务或Agent运行。assets.created_at在既有表契约已声明，真实覆盖与创建来源/迁移隔离待核实。

columns.name: source_refs_json

columns.name: rank
columns.label_zh: 按首次建档时间倒序的序号

columns.name: calculated_at
columns.label_zh: 本批结果生成时间，不是建档时间

case.caption_zh: 虚构输入；迁移/导入标记与来源引用均为演算假设，未写入真实库。
